project_info.application_name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Management System
project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier cloud architecture with external charging stations connecting through Network Load Balancer to containerized services on ECS/Fargate. Web application served via CloudFront CDN with API Gateway for REST APIs. Internal microservices communicate through Application Load Balancer. Clear separation between public-facing components (web app, OCPP handlers) and internal microservices (EVSE management, smart charging, transaction management). External integrations with fleet management, smart meters, and roaming networks.
